Guild snapshot persistence and idempotent integration actor registration.

Refactored onto the shared grant validator with unchanged behavior.
Best-effort login-time guild snapshot that never blocks login or overwrites durable state on failure.
Guild read model added to the passport response.
PassportGuild contract with explicit member-null-means-unverified semantics.
Community status row and community card with loading, setup-required, unverified, joined, and not-joined states plus manual re-sync action.
Guild card styling reusing the existing card system.
Nullable guild membership snapshot columns on players.
Generated D1 migration adding the guild snapshot columns.
Signature binding, timestamp window, fail-closed configuration, cooldown, and shared validation tests.
Documents the new optional guild and integration environment values without secret material.
Owner runbook for Discord application, bot, secrets, rotation, reconciliation, and pre-production gate checks.

Immutable state transition input for the community and automation enablement milestone.
